correctness.rationale: The normal form works over every commutative k-algebra B, which is needed for the scheme claim, not just for field-valued points. Write R=B⊗K and A=M_α. The derived ideal equals R, and a derivation with t-component a has [D|_R,A]=aA; commuting with A on the right gives 0=[D|_R,f(A)]=aAf′(A). Both A and f′(A) have inverses over k and hence over B, giving a=0. Since R=B[A] is cyclic and free as the regular rank-one R-module, an endomorphism commuting with A is a multiplication. Symmetry and this calculation give precisely (w,b,c), with the converse verified from the derivation formula. The post-Lie identity at (t,1,1) gives cα=0, and at (t,1,t) with c=0 gives bα=b². Conversely the R left multiplications then kill R, commute with each other, and their commutator with L_t is L_[t,x] by b²=αb. Functorially the scheme is the free w affine space times the idempotent scheme of R; over the algebraic closure e_i²−e_i=0 splits into distinct roots including in characteristic two. Frobenius gives a length-d cycle on embeddings, so its s-th power fixes 2^g binary words; inversion by divisors shows the stated necklace multiplicity and the weight q^(de) per Euler factor. Over F_(q^s), choosing j factors gives image eR plus the span of w, with dimensions and counts as in the polynomial (the j=g outside term is zero). The automorphism action preserves b=0,α; for t↦at+u and G on K with GA=aAG, transport sends w to a^(−2)Gw−2a^(−1)bu. Thus no omitted automorphism mixes zero and nonzero w when the translation term vanishes, and multiplication on K is already transitive on nonzero w. Independent basis-triple testing for F2[x]/(x⁴+x+1), α=x, enumerated all 4096 biderivation parameter triples and gave 32 CPA products with ranks 0,1,4 occurring 1,15,16 times. That check assumes the proved normal form, and tests neither geometric smoothness nor the general zeta identity.

evidence: The complex three-dimensional global CPA variety has two varying operations; the 2026 paper does not state the finite-field fixed-bracket fiber. Burde–Moens give a degree-one affine analogue in characteristic zero. Di Bartolo–La Rosa assume completeness, whereas here Der has dimension 2d and ad has dimension d+1, with d≥2. Avetisyan treats derivations and automorphisms of the ambient almost Abelian Lie algebra.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Neither a result for perfect/complete brackets nor a global three-dimensional characteristic-zero classification gives this all-degree finite-field scheme. Avetisyan's framework yields useful inputs, but the product equations and their rank and Frobenius consequences still have to be computed.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Independent split coordinates in every d, the idempotent equation over the actual étale base algebra, and the span of w outside the selected factors are the ingredients determining the extension counts and rank profile. Neither the low-dimensional classifications nor almost-Abelian derivation structure alone implies these formulas.

originality.rationale: The distinct claim is the fixed-bracket CPA scheme and its arithmetic and image-rank classification for every irreducible invertible action of the stated form over finite fields. The degree-one affine example and some dimension-three split product forms are prior; general structural Lie-algebra results and similarly shaped Nijenhuis results do not give the target census.
residual_risks: No exhaustive literature or priority claim. The complex dimension-three list is prior evidence for some split forms and is not credited as new here.
The v1 introduction and formal G1 statement of arXiv:2602.00614 disagree on the dimension/component count of the global variety; neither count is used to exclude overlap with individual split forms.

value.rationale: For a natural irreducible-action family, the result explains why the rational product census sees only two choices of action while the geometric fiber has exponentially many components, and precisely how scalar extension makes new ranks appear. The all-degree zeta and rank formulas are usable on the fixed Lie algebra without reclassifying products after each extension. The result adds arithmetic and image information beyond known ambient-algebra structure or low-dimensional models.
